title: MITRE ATT&CK Tactic Sequence Explorer
description: Step through preset attack campaigns and watch each technique appear as a circle in the column of its MITRE ATT&CK tactic, analyzing how techniques chain into a full campaign and where a SOC could first detect it.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Identify which MITRE ATT&CK tactic a given technique belongs to.
Analyze how individual techniques chain into a complete attack campaign.
Reason about the earliest point at which a SOC could detect an intrusion.
educational.prerequisites: Familiarity with the cyber kill chain and basic SOC concepts.

pedagogical.interaction: Scenario dropdown, step forward/back, play-all with speed control, click-to-inspect technique tooltips.
pedagogical.assessment: Discussion prompts in the lesson plan ask students to name the tactic and earliest detection point for each step.
pedagogical.misconceptions: Counters the idea that attacks are single events by showing them as multi-tactic sequences.
